purpose: Freeze independently authored holdout and labels before any model request
authoring_context: Isolated AI context with no access to candidate prompts, development data, historical model reports, or credentials
label_review: Main agent checked all policies and labels before model calls; no human domain-expert validation is claimed
scope: Synthetic model contract/development holdout, not financial expert labels, production accuracy, or semantic retrieval evaluation. H03/H04 use hypothetical 18-decimal ledgers as numerical stress cases, not current Core MySQL amount storage examples.
post_result_policy: Preserve labels, prompts, datasets and all failures unchanged; any future tuning requires a new development version and a new unseen holdout.
